text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three years spent with North Flight in 
the Twinkle Series. They were truly 
dazzling days.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And as for North Flight right now—

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—I couldn't produce results in graded 
races... And I've lost my confidence, too.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I thought... that maybe I don't belong in 
this place, at Tracen Academy...

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if it's just on the outside. I 
wondered if gaining some confidence might 
change something."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"So, that's why you came to consult with 
me."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Would it be alright... if I watched you 
for a little while?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh? Y... Yes...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I think... black would suit you 
very well.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Black...? ...It might be a little too cool 
for me.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Black is a sophisticated color. Even a 
single piece will sharpen someone's 
presence and elevate their overall look.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Besides, a hue untouched by anything else 
is sure to give you confidence.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder if that's true. If I do 
that... maybe I can become cool like you, 
Senpai...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "You can. No... you will."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"There's no such thing... as being 
'unworthy'! You make yourself worthy. By 
putting on a confident front!"

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Senpai...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It might take some time. Even so... we'll 
definitely find the perfect outfit for you 
one day.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I was like that too. So... you can 
definitely shine too!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Um... thank you very much! I'll take a 
longer view of things and do my best!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Feel free to come talk to me anytime! 
I'm rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm off to change! —Into an 
outfit that's totally me♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, together with North Flight, I am 
attending the anniversary party of her 
favorite boutique.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is a dress code every year, and this 
year's theme is... 'Being Yourself'. It's 
meant to be a surprise on the day of, so I 
haven't been told what she'll wear, but—
choice_data_list:
(Without a doubt... it has to be that 
outfit.)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: âAh, that's right.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Trainer's "be yourself" outfit! In other 
words, your everyday clothes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, when thinking about what outfit felt 
most like 'me'... I realized what I wear 
for training every day is what suits me 
best."
choice_data_list:
You went with your racing outfit after 
all, huh.

You went with your racing outfit too, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu, did you figure me out?
choice_data_list: Because that's what's most like you.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"This outfit brings out my charm better 
than anything else."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"On the stage I chose, where my raw 
material shines brightest... In the race."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Because when I'm running, that's when I'm 
most truly myself!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her acknowledge me with a beaming 
smile, I wonder... what about myself? I've 
worked hard so I could be someone worthy 
of her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I've tried to make my own natural 
qualities shine. What I learned from her 
love of fashion was to love myself... so—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Pardon?
choice_data_list:
I think the me right now is the most 'me' 
I've ever been!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: That's wonderful, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"A confident smile... is what suits you 
best!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, I want to send a photo to Big 
Sis too! Would you take one with me?

text_block_list.name: Shop Customer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look... It's Flight-san and 
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Shop Customer
text_block_list.text:
Those two—no matter when you look at them, 
they're such a perfect match!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After the party ended, I stepped outside—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Aaaargh!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I found you, Flight-san!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Huh, Bakushin O-chan—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Because you're like that too, Flight-san!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I saw it with my own eyes! Flight-san 
heading out in her racing silks!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So you mean the race schedule, right?! 
Gosh, you scared me! I thought—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"The idea of you running without me at 
your side... is simply unthinkable!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-chan...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's quite all right, I understand! You 
just had a slight slip of the mind and 
forgot to invite me, didn't you?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Aren't you lucky to have a Class Rep 
who's both brilliant and the fastest 
around?!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then! Where are we running 
today!?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I suppose so~...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Well then, maybe I'll ask Trainer to do 
it.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
――A supreme race that's just perfect for 
us! Would you coordinate it for us?
choice_data_list:
Of course! I'll make it the best outfit 
ever!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If you just think about it in your own 
way... I'm sure it'll be perfect♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Bakushin O-chan! Time for us to 
warm up!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I'm heading on ahead, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if chasing after the two who sprinted 
off—a vapor trail stretched out long, so 
very long across the sky.
